load_config_yaml: load a YAML configuration file from a given path and return the parsed dictionary
run_faiss_sanity_check: run a sanity check that verifies FAISS CPU and GPU search results match on synthetic data
calculate_margin: calculate the margin between query vector pairs using pairwise distances and a threshold
compute_intersection_frequencies: compute the frequencies of intersection cardinalities between predicted and ground truth neighbor indices
check_pretransform_index: check whether a FAISS index is an IndexPreTransform type and has a chain attribute
